jica_manual_ref: Inspired by JICA SHEP PLUS — Cabbage production manual

varieties.name: Gloria F1
varieties.supplier_notes: Most popular hybrid in Central + Rift; uniform 2-3kg heads.

varieties.name: Pruktor F1
varieties.supplier_notes: Holds in field 3+ weeks past maturity without splitting.

timeline_template.description_en: Sow seed in raised nursery at 1cm depth, 5cm apart in rows 15cm.
timeline_template.description_sw: Panda mbegu kitalu chenye kuinuka kina 1cm, umbali wa 5cm na safu 15cm.

timeline_template.description_en: Reduce watering and expose to sun 5 days before transplant.
timeline_template.description_sw: Punguza maji na peleka jua siku 5 kabla ya kupandikiza.
Pandikiza miche wiki 5 nafasi ya 60cm x 45cm.

timeline_template.description_en: Apply 100kg DAP at planting (split into holes).
timeline_template.description_sw: Weka kilo 100 za DAP wakati wa kupanda.

timeline_template.description_en: Hand-weed and earth up around base for stability.
timeline_template.description_sw: Palia kwa mkono na rundisha udongo karibu na mmea.

timeline_template.description_en: Spray for diamondback moth + aphids if scout threshold exceeded.
timeline_template.description_sw: Nyunyuza dawa ya wadudu ikiwa wamezidi.

timeline_template.description_en: Second 50kg CAN dose at head-formation stage.
timeline_template.description_sw: Dosi ya pili ya CAN kilo 50 wakati kichwa kinaanza.

timeline_template.description_en: Cut heads at the base with sharp knife when firm and 2kg+.
timeline_template.description_sw: Kata vichwa chini kwa kisu mkali vikishuka 2kg+.
timeline_template.tip_en: Harvest in cool morning hours to extend shelf life.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Vuna asubuhi mapema kuongeza muda wa kuhifadhi.

post_harvest.grading_criteria: Grade A: 2kg+, tight head, no insect damage. Grade B: 1.2-2kg or minor damage.
post_harvest.packaging_standard: Stacked loose in pickup; large heads in 50kg hessian sacks.
post_harvest.storage_tips_en: Cool dark storage 0-4°C holds 3+ months. At room temp, sell within 2 weeks.
post_harvest.storage_tips_sw: Hifadhi 0-4°C miezi 3+. Joto la kawaida — uza ndani ya wiki 2.
